dial_exists_in_code: NO. src/managent/main.zig carries only the five-level Appetite enum (off / probe / conserve / spend / reserved); there is no 0–9 numeric dial field. The S06 spec ORC-POL-3 (T813, 'the dial and the class are two first-class configurations') defines the dial but the spec itself notes 'the 0–9 dial exists in no tracked source file'.
what_is_unexpressed: The ruling's dial half — equal RATE (dial 5 for all eight, oxalpha 9) — is unexpressed. The class half lands: all eight equal-opportunity models and oxalpha are spend, Fable reserved, qwen probe. So the table is permitted-equally (all eight eligible for the draw), which is WEAKER than drawn-equally (equal eagerness). The dial is not faked by overloading the enum; the ruling is therefore not fully satisfied in code until S06 pass 1 lands the policy file.

note_for_s06_pass1: The appetite table is compiled into src/managent/main.zig with no file or environment override, so a roster change the operator wanted immediately cost a source edit, a rebuild, a deploy, and a slot in a seven-task one-writer chain (T767 → T768 → T775 → T786/T798 → T815 → T816 → T833 queue behind this head). That is exactly the blocker S06 pass 1 (the policy file) exists to remove; this task is the worked example.
